about: The font registry (renderer/CONTRACT.md C49): family id -> its TTF and licence in this folder. tools/gen_fonts.py builds a family at every size a built-in theme (themes/*.json) names for it, with the glyph sets of the styles it draws; a theme may name any family here with source builtin. weights = the weights the file has (a style takes the nearest; bold is synthetic). grid = pixels per em of a pixel font: at a whole multiple of it the family is built 1 bpp (crisp), else 4 bpp. fallback: true = glyphs the family lacks are drawn by Facet's font (else a missing glyph fails the build). Licences: SIL OFL 1.1 only. Facet's own families (Inter, JetBrains Mono) come from tokens/type.json and are not listed. A new family = its .ttf + licence text here and one entry: no code edit.
